title: Repeat of two round-1 suggestions still open: (a) the wrapper parses only .mode…
description:
Repeat of two round-1 suggestions still open: (a) the wrapper parses only .model and .effort and ignores the .backend the resolver prints, so a mid-session backend switch to codex would feed a codex slug to the hardcoded `claude --model` (same mismatch already exists on main at the initial spawn, so not a regression, but live re-resolution makes it reachable mid-session); (b) readPhaseEffort returns any non-empty string, so `efforts.orchestrator = 'maximum'` flows into --effort and into the audit event (claude 2.1.220 only warns and falls back, per the official CLI reference tier set low|medium|high|xhigh|max), recording a tier claude never applied.

Source: cam/issue-425
Review round: 2
